name: Temporary Residence Permit Through Marriage / Dependent Residence

requirements.blocker_text: Spouse or minor child of an Ethiopian national or a foreign resident permit holder, per Immigration Proclamation No. 354/2002 Art. 15(2).

sources.title: Immigration and Citizenship Service (ICS), Ethiopia -- service catalogue confirms 'Temporary Residence Permit Through Marriage' as an active service category; base residence framework for minor children under Immigration Proclamation No. 354/2002 Art. 15(2)

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Ethiopia). STATUS: DRAFT -- the tier-1 ICS source confirms the service exists but discloses no eligibility, duration, or fee detail. GAP: no rules were found for parent/adult-child family reunification -- only spouse and minor children are documented. A separate tier-3/4 law-firm source (not cited here since not used for a hard requirement) states that dependent/spousal residence does NOT automatically confer work rights -- adult dependents must separately obtain a work permit, and even spouses of investors/expatriates require a distinct authorization under Investment Proclamation Art. 22(3) rather than an automatic derivative right; this shaped the conservative work_rights='none' default here but is itself unconfirmed at tier-1/2. citizenship_after_months (24, reflecting the 2-years-married-plus-1-year-residence marriage citizenship track) and pr_after_months (12) are cross-referenced from et_citizenship_by_marriage.json and et_permanent_residence.json respectively.
